title: 9 第9章 十二元辰破四海乘雾神君10 第10章 碧灵五毒
slug: 明尊第九十六章西方颢天沧海横流

第9章十二元辰破四海，乘雾神君
钱晨仿佛真的是一个赶路的文弱士子一般，每日自在官道上缓缓跋涉，有时看到日头太大，还会寻处阴凉躲避，除了每时每刻运转胎息，纯化道基，以及每日子午二时，雷打不动的打坐运功之外。并未与凡俗有任何不同。
这种难得古代世俗体验，钱晨并不讨厌，甚至还有点新奇。
他每夜里在旅店听着过往的商旅路人诉说自己的故事，白日里赶路奔波，恍如这芸芸众生，渐渐身上那超然脱俗的气息被磨洗去，有些泯然众人的味道了。
“原来这就是凡人的感觉。”钱晨捏着有些酸痛的脚趾暗道：“和我原来的世界真是截然不同，第一次体会这个世界的平凡人的生活，有种深度游的感觉。”
念罢，他自嘲的笑了笑：“之前脑子里都是楼观道那些成仙得道的先辈的想法，一堆正道真传弟子高高在上的念头，如今才第一次知道这个世界普通人的感觉。先前都没发现，自己这么不接地气了。”
“快到临海城了吧！”钱晨自官道尽头窥见了路边树荫见露出的幌子一角，默运目力去看，却见幌子上绣了一个斗大的茶字。
他走到跟前，果然发现道边支起来的一个茶摊，面貌老实的店家正在烧水煮茶，虽然摊子不大，却是钱晨一路走来见过最干净的。钱晨寻个地方坐下，向那茶摊主人问道：“店家，这里距离临海城还有多远？”
“莫约就二十里路了！”店家憨厚道：“客人可是去参加洪四海大侠的千岁宴的？”
“嗯！”钱晨微微一愣，摇头道：“我是个读书人，不参合这些江湖事。”说完便好奇问道：“洪四海大侠六十大寿，往来的江湖豪客很多吗？”
“洪大侠乃是本地的魁首，四海堂坐镇临海，谁人不知谁人不晓啊！当年他率领正道群雄，大破魔教，亲手毙魔教教主于掌下，为武林除去这一大祸害，得到江湖同道共尊为武林盟主。这段故事，往来的客人常说，我听得耳朵都起茧子了！”
“客人可要来一碗热茶？”
虽然钱晨正在筑基关口，不饮浊水，但人家都跟你套了这么久热乎了。你不来碗茶照顾生意，合适吗？所以钱晨知情知趣道：“那就来一碗吧！”
同时心里暗道：“这四海堂好大势力，连路边的小摊店家都知道洪四海要办寿宴了。这种热闹，常常麻烦最多，就是不知道是仇家灭门啊？还是江湖纠纷？这个世界武力值不低，宗师便相当于突破了中土的感应关卡，多半能运用天地元气。摸着高武的门槛了！”
“修道结丹之前，肉身脆弱，只能依靠法器逞威。若是被人摸近身前突袭，猝不及防之下，来不及祭起法器，被修行武功的宗师杀掉也是寻常。我切不可大意，天罗伞必须常伴身边，勾动气机，以保证反应最快。”
正思索着呢！茶摊主人已经奉上一壶热茶。
钱晨谢过店家，随手将茶壶放在身边，他看店家笑呵呵的看着他，恍然大悟，排出几枚铜钱付了帐。正要继续思索如何提高天罗伞的响应速度，却突然眉头一皱，随手从背后的书箱上取下葫芦，将茶水倒入葫芦中，一副要路上备用的样子。
“这样就不会有人奇怪我为什么不喝茶了吧！”
钱晨暗自点头道，出门在外，就两个字——谨慎！
那茶摊主人看到钱晨面前的热茶倒完了，连忙道：“哎呦！忘了给客人添水了！您等着，我给您再上一壶，我们这里续茶不要钱。”

钱晨却抬手笑道：“那感情好，但我葫芦没有加满，您再给添一点水罢！”说着摇了摇葫芦，里面哗哗的水声，显然只填了一半左右。
那店主人看了巴掌大小的红葫芦一眼，暗道：“这葫芦不大，容量还不小。”便伸手接过葫芦，正要打开葫芦塞，这时葫芦口突然喷出一股黄色水雾，却是那一壶茶水被钱晨藏了一手内力，只等店主人接过，葫芦口对着面部就忽然爆发。
淡黄色的水雾喷在了店主人的脸上，瞬间就僵化了他脸上的一半肌肉。
这时候，店主人的表情已经完全变了，他左半边的脸表情狰狞，右半边被喷了水雾的脸却已经僵硬，被牵扯的一阵阵抽动，扭曲如同恶鬼。
“终日打雁，却被小雁儿啄了眼！”店主人脸色阴沉，狞笑道：“好精明的小子，你怎么知道我的茶有问题。”
“应该我先问才对。”钱晨郁闷道：“我是哪里出了破绽，你怎么知道我不是路过的普通人？”
“我明明已经化妆显老了啊！”
“现在看你简直浑身都是破绽，但当时你装的虽然有漏洞，但已足以取信于人。所以我并不知道你这小雁儿不简单。”店主人狞笑道。
“那你为何毒我？”钱晨表情十分无辜。自己不过赶路前往临海城，路上没招谁没惹谁的，主线任务都还没有线索，怎么就冒出个人来想要毒死自己。
“哈哈……”那店主人仰头一笑：“我……”
他话未出口人已经弹了出去，伸手之间，一点金光飞纵，这时候钱晨竟然感觉此人浑身精气神都融入那一点金光之中，随着金光离体，此人的身体仿佛只剩下一具躯壳。那一线金光快如闪电，只在动念之间，便来到钱晨的面前。

Chapter 9: Twelve Yuan Chen breaks through the four seas, riding on the mist god
Qian Chen seemed like a weak scholar on the road. He trudged slowly on the official road every day. Sometimes when the sun was too bright, he would find a cool place to hide. In addition to running the fetal breath every moment, purifying the Tao foundation, and doing the unbeatable meditation exercise at two o'clock every day. It's not any different from the ordinary.
Qian Chen didn't dislike this rare ancient worldly experience, it was even a bit novel.
He listened to the business travelers telling their stories in the hotel every night. He rushed around during the day, just like all living beings. Gradually, the otherworldly aura in his body was washed away, and he became a bit like everyone else.
"So this is what it feels like to be a mortal." Qian Chen pinched his sore toes and said to himself: "It's really completely different from my old world. It's the first time I experience the life of ordinary people in this world, and it feels like I'm traveling in depth."
After reading, he smiled mockingly to himself: "Before, my mind was filled with the thoughts of the ancestors of Louguan Tao who became immortals, and the lofty thoughts of a bunch of true disciples of the righteous path. Now, for the first time, I know the feelings of ordinary people in this world. I never realized before that I am so out of touch with the world."
"We're almost at Linhai City!" Qian Chen peeked from the end of the official road and saw the corner of the cover exposed by the shade of the trees on the roadside. He looked at it silently and saw a big Chinese character "tea" embroidered on the cover.
When he walked up to it, he found a tea stall set up by the roadside. The honest-looking shopkeeper was boiling water and making tea. Although the stall was not big, it was the cleanest one Qian Chen had seen along the way. Qian Chen found a place to sit down and asked the tea stall owner: "Staff, how far is it from Linhai City?"
"Mo Yue is only twenty miles away!" the store owner said honestly, "Are you going to attend the Thousand Years Banquet of Hero Hong Sihai?"
"Yeah!" Qian Chen was stunned for a moment, shook his head and said, "I'm a scholar, and I don't get involved in these worldly affairs." After saying that, he asked curiously: "It's the 60th birthday of the great hero Hong Sihai. Are there many wealthy people coming and going?"
"Hong Daxia is the leader of the local area. The Sihaitang is based in Linhai. Everyone knows who doesn't know it! Back then, he led the heroes of the righteous path to defeat the Demon Sect and killed the leader of the Demon Sect with his own hands. He eliminated this great scourge for the martial arts world and was respected as the leader of the martial arts alliance by all the people in the world. This story is often told by guests who come and go, and it makes my ears go numb!"
"Would the guest like a bowl of hot tea?"
Although Qian Chen is at the foundation building pass and does not drink dirty water, people have been tricking you for so long. Is it appropriate for you not to come to Wan Cha to take care of business? So Qian Chen knew what was going on and said, "Then let's have a bowl!"
At the same time, he thought to himself: "This Sihaitang is so powerful that even the roadside stall owners know that Hong Sihai is going to hold a birthday party. This kind of excitement is often the most troublesome. Is it because the enemy is destroying the family? Or is it a dispute between the rivers and lakes? The value of martial arts in this world is not low, and a grandmaster is equivalent to breaking through the induction level of Middle-earth. He can probably use the vitality of heaven and earth. He is touching the threshold of high martial arts!"
"Before practicing Taoism and forming elixirs, my body was fragile and I could only rely on magic weapons to show off my power. If someone approached me and made a surprise attack, I was caught off guard and had no time to sacrifice my magic weapon. It was also common for me to be killed by a master practicing martial arts. I must not be careless. The Tianluo Umbrella must always be by my side to activate my energy to ensure the fastest response."
Just thinking about it! The tea stall owner has served a pot of hot tea.
Qian Chen thanked the shopkeeper and put the teapot beside him. When he saw the shopkeeper looking at him with a smile, he suddenly understood and paid the bill with a few copper coins. Just as he was about to continue thinking about how to improve the response speed of Tianluo Umbrella, he suddenly frowned, casually took the gourd from the bookcase behind his back, poured the tea into the gourd, and looked like he would have it ready for the road.
"This way no one will wonder why I don't drink tea!"
Qian Chen nodded secretly and said, just two words when going out - be cautious!
The tea stall owner saw what was in front of Qian ChenAfter pouring the hot tea, he quickly said: "Ouch! I forgot to refill the water for the guest! Just wait, I will give you another pot. We don't charge for refilling the tea here."
Qian Chen raised his hand and said with a smile: "That's a good feeling, but my gourd is not full. Please add some more water!" As he said this, he shook the gourd. There was a sound of water rushing inside, and it was obvious that it was only about half full.
The shop owner glanced at the palm-sized red gourd and said to himself: "This gourd is not big, and the capacity is not small." He reached out to take the gourd and was about to open the stopper of the gourd when a stream of yellow water mist suddenly spurted out from the gourd mouth. It was the pot of tea that Qian Chen had hidden in his hand. Just waiting for the shop owner to take it, the gourd mouth suddenly erupted towards his face.
The light yellow water mist sprayed on the shop owner's face, instantly stiffening half of the muscles on his face.
At this time, the shop owner's expression had completely changed. The left half of his face had a ferocious expression, but the right half of his face, which had been sprayed with water mist, was stiff, twitching and twisted like an evil ghost.
"I hunt geese all day long, but I got pecked in the eye by a little wild goose!" The shop owner looked gloomy and said with a sinister smile: "You are such a shrewd boy, how did you know there was something wrong with my tea?"
"I should have asked first." Qian Chen said depressedly: "Where is the flaw in me? How do you know that I am not an ordinary person passing by?"
"I've obviously put on makeup to look older!"
"You look like you are full of flaws now, but at that time, even though you pretended to have flaws, it was enough to win people's trust. So I didn't know that you, little goose, were not simple." The shop owner said with a cruel smile.
"Then why did you poison me?" Qian Chen looked very innocent. I just hurried to Linhai City. I didn't provoke anyone on the way. I didn't even have any clues about the main mission. Why did someone show up and want to poison me.
"Haha..." The shop owner looked up and smiled: "I..."
Before he could say anything, the person had already been ejected, and between his hands, a bit of golden light flew across his hand. At this time, Qian Chen felt that the person's entire body and energy were integrated into that bit of golden light. As the golden light left his body, it seemed as if only a shell was left in the person's body. That ray of golden light was as fast as lightning, and it came to Qian Chen in just a moment's thought.
